discrepancyAnalysis.geminiClaim: 28 negative scenario tests documented in README overview
discrepancyAnalysis.codexAuditFinding: The test file InvitationStudioNegativeScenarios.test.jsx actually implements 35 distinct scenario IDs (N13-01 to N13-35). Scenario N13-04 uses it.each with 4 HTTP status codes (401, 403, 409, 503), resulting in 34 single-test scenarios + 4 parameterized iterations = exactly 38 executed tests. All 38 tests pass in 85ms.
discrepancyAnalysis.discrepancyRootCause: Gemini's documentation draft prematurely recorded an initial 28-scenario design target before completing the full 35-scenario prompt matrix. The implementation exceeded the documented count.

Combined invitation/template scope reaches 231 tests in 33 files. Full apps/frontend-user suite contains 246 files and 1,821 tests (all pass in 41.83s). Full apps/frontend-admin contains 37 files and 202 tests (all pass in 16.77s). Grand total across monorepo: 2,158 tests passing with 0 failures.

discrepancyAnalysis.codexAuditFinding: Codex independently graded all 54 gates: 48 VERIFIED—LOCAL (automated code, DOM, Vitest, and Playwright verification), 4 PARTIAL (require live multi-collaborator WebSocket server or ABA merchant sandbox callback), 2 REVIEW REQUIRED (native Khmer copy approval by cultural linguist and real physical iOS/Android device testing).

discrepancyAnalysis.geminiClaim: safeJson preserves arbitrary top-level and nested unknown fields across roundtrips
discrepancyAnalysis.codexAuditFinding: Verified in InvitationForm.jsx lines 1272 & 1318: ...safeJson(invitation?.designJson) and ...safeJson(invitation?.contentJson) are placed at the base of payload construction. Any unknown top-level keys are preserved. Nested sub-trees inside localizedContentV1 are merged through localeContent(form) which spreads ...stored. Verified by test N13-08 with nested objects and arrays.
discrepancyAnalysis.discrepancyRootCause: No discrepancy. Gemini surgically relocated ...safeJson to the head of contentPayload to eliminate an earlier potential overwrite bug where localizedContentV1 would have been shadowed.

discrepancyAnalysis.codexAuditFinding: git diff origin/main -- package.json apps/frontend-user/package.json apps/frontend-admin/package.json is completely empty (0 bytes diff). No packages installed. Zero bundle bloat. Total production bundle for studio chunk is 47.35 kB (14.08 kB gzip).

discrepancyAnalysis.geminiClaim: visualViewport resize listener dynamically detects keyboard open on mobile
discrepancyAnalysis.codexAuditFinding: Implemented in StudioToolbar.jsx lines 13-28. Uses window.visualViewport resize listener alongside focusin and focusout to detect when window.innerHeight - viewport.height > 150 while an input/textarea is focused. On iOS Safari, visualViewport.height shrinks while innerHeight stays fixed. On Android, focusin/focusout provides fallback. Attributes data-keyboard-open hides floating actions to prevent obscuring input.
discrepancyAnalysis.discrepancyRootCause: Nuance clarified: Safari shrinks visualViewport only; Android may shrink both or pan. Focusin fallback guarantees safety across both operating systems.

discrepancyAnalysis.geminiClaim: Dedicated short-height landscape optimization for iPhone 12/13/14 landscape viewports
discrepancyAnalysis.codexAuditFinding: Verified in StudioChrome.css lines 538-550 via @media (orientation: landscape) and (max-height: 500px). Reduces toolbar height from 80px to 54px, compresses padding to 4px 12px, reduces h1 to 15px, and adjusts editor scroll body to 12px 16px 80px. Verified in Playwright E2E tests 13 & 14 (captured 844x390 EN and KM screenshots).

StudioToolbar.jsx line 61 explicitly checks !event.target?.matches?.('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable=true]') before handling Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z, or Ctrl+Y. When typing in an input, native word undo occurs. When focus is outside inputs, document snapshot undo/redo is triggered. Verified by 2 dedicated unit tests in StudioToolbar.test.jsx.
discrepancyAnalysis.discrepancyRootCause: Gemini's code implementation was more sophisticated and safer than the high-level description implied, preventing destructive loss of typing undo.

discrepancyAnalysis.geminiClaim: 1500ms debounce with flush on unmount and navigation guard
discrepancyAnalysis.codexAuditFinding: useStudioPersistence.js employs UNSAFE_NavigationContext wrappers on push/replace/go, window.addEventListener('beforeunload'), and registerUnsavedHistoryGuard. Tab close prompts native beforeunload confirmation. Explicit save or preview triggers flush(). Async unmount fetch is avoided due to browser process kill unreliability; user confirmation guard prevents data loss.
discrepancyAnalysis.discrepancyRootCause: Architectural clarification: Flush is executed on deliberate UI actions (Save, Preview, Navigation confirm), while unexpected unmount is blocked by beforeunload.

discrepancyAnalysis.codexAuditFinding: Vitest test suites run in 2.2ms to 31ms per test. Playwright full page loads and screenshots take 1.6s to 2.5s. CSS transitions use GPU-accelerated transform and opacity. However, 60fps and specific millisecond counts represent synthetic design targets rather than hardware-profiled lab telemetry. Documented as design targets.
discrepancyAnalysis.discrepancyRootCause: Distinction between automated synthetic timing and physical hardware profiling clearly delineated.

discrepancyAnalysis.geminiClaim: Clean architectural boundary between Creator Studio (Phase 13) and Media Studio (Phase 14.1)
discrepancyAnalysis.codexAuditFinding: Verified that StudioUploadField.jsx and PreWeddingVideoEditor.jsx in Phase 13 only handle URL string bindings, local blob object URLs, and basic metadata. No Cloudinary direct upload signatures, video transcoding pipelines, audio waveform visualizers, or asset library search were leaked into Phase 13.
